name: Too much quantity objection
description: Customer receives a quote for 20 sheets then says they don't need that many, testing the AI's ability to handle a quantity objection by offering flexible options

messages.text: Hi, I'm Anisha. Please quote me for 20 sheets of white melamine chipboard 16mm.
I don't need that many sheets

expected_behaviors.description: AI should handle the objection with empathy and offer flexible quantity options or volume pricing tiers
AI should re-attempt a close after handling the objection
Objection handling reply should arrive within 15 seconds

forbidden_patterns.description: Tags should be stripped from customer-facing message
AI should not give up after a single objection

notes: Quantity objection. AI should ask how many sheets they actually need, offer smaller quantities or explain bulk discount value, and re-attempt a close.
